records.title: Circulation of Digital e-Rupee
details:
(b): Currently, e₹ is in pilot stage and the objective of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is to test multiple use cases that can be served by e₹. The pilot started with person to person and person to merchant payments and subsequently, offline and programmable functionalities are
also being tested. The specific feature of programmability is being leveraged for multiple
Direct Benefit Transfer schemes. The technical architecture is also being reviewed on an on-
going basis and multiple functionalities like interoperability with UPI, capability to process
decimal payments etc. have been introduced. RBI also plans to conduct Public Awareness
Campaigns to educate the citizens of the country about digital e-Rupee’s features.
(c): RBI is engaging bilaterally with the Central Banks of UAE, Bank of Mauritius, Monetary Authority of Singapore, and participating in multilateral projects of the Bank of International Settlements (BIS) Innovation Hub Singapore for Project Mandala and Project Rialto to further improve cross-border payment processing and settlement using digital e-Rupee. However, all of the above initiatives are currently in the exploratory stage, and no cross-border arrangements have been made operational at present.

records.title: State Legislatures under NeVA
details: a to b: Yes. The Government of India has entered into Tripartite Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with 28 State/UT Legislatures and the concerned State Government, including Punjab, for implementation of the National e-Vidhan Application (NeVA) in the respective Legislatures.

records.title: Electrification/Broad Gauge Lines in Punjab.
details: a to c): There is only one narrow gauge rail line falling fully/partly in the state of Punjab i.e. Pathankot to Joginder Nagar (200 km). The survey for gauge conversion of this line has been sanctioned and survey work has been taken up for preparation of Detailed Project Report.

records.title: NH Projects in Punjab
details: a to d: The Government is taking requisite measures in consultation with all the stakeholders including the State Govt. of Punjab for resolving the land acquisition issues and obtaining requisite clearances.

records.title: Medical College in Gurdaspur
details: (a) to (c): Under the Scheme, 03 medical colleges (SAS Nagar in Phase-I and Kapurthala and Hoshiarpur in Phase-III) have been approved in Punjab. Government Medical College at SAS Nagar is functional.
